stages.name: superconducting magnet (5 T option)

stages.name: VTI sample space (continuous gas flow)
stages.quote: Variable temperature. Closed circuit gas flow VTI with continuous sample temperature control from 1.6 Kelvin to 400 Kelvin.

sample_space.description: Top-loading DC resistivity/Hall probe inserted down the 30 mm ID VTI into the magnet bore; two 6-contact sample sockets, one parallel and one perpendicular to B; sample in flowing helium gas, 1.6-400 K.

diameter_or_width.quote: Sample space of 25 mm or 30 mm in the VTI

notes: Outer dimensions come from the dimension callouts on the Cryogenic m-CFMS flyer photo (page 1): the 900 mm arrow is vertical beside the cryostat, 440 mm runs across the front of the base, 660 mm along the side (verified by rendering the PDF page). Stage temperatures: the m-CFMS product page gives pulse tube base <3 K and VTI 1.6-400 K; the magnet is conduction-cooled by the same cryocooler (same page: 'Cooling for both the magnet and the sample space is provided by a cryocooler'), so it is modelled at the cryocooler stage temperature. The dc_twisted_pair wiring entry has count 0 because the brochure names twisted pairs as a wiring option but gives no count; the six-contact-per-socket figure (two sockets) is from the Resistivity and Hall Effect product page for the standard DC probe. Optical access (VTI-base) and He-3 insert are options NOT fitted in this configuration, hence windows count 0. The 25 mm VTI variant on the m-CFMS page quotes a '100 mm long isothermal region, with a possibility of a single optical access'; this configuration uses the 30 mm VTI so that length is not applied.
